column4: This list is intended to be used as a starting point for piping material and valve selections for utility services, to be modified as required for project-specific conditions and contract requirements.

Pressures and temperatures in this list do not necessarily reflect typical service conditions, but are intended as boundaries on the standard material selections.  If actual project service conditions are outside these boundaries, then the selections require specific review by mechanical/materials engineer.
Note that valve service limits may differ from pipe service limits, and may also differ between manufacturers, and must be confirmed to meet the project service conditions.
For safety reasons, thermoplastic piping (e.g. CPVC, PVC) is not to be pneumatically tested.

For use on a project, copy the applicable utilities to 5-LST-0003-1: Piping Service List (Chemical Plant), 5-LST-0003-2: Piping Service List (Acid Plant) or 5-LST-0003-3: Piping Serivce List (Spent Acid Plant) as applicable.
